run_deep_research_workflow: run the deep research action to create a plan, investigate topics, and synthesize findings into a report
create_deep_research_action_model: create a DeepResearchAction Pydantic model with type and id fields to track workflow actions
define_action_schema: define an ActionSchema with api_key and topic inputs and report, actions, and user_log outputs
spawn_sub_actions: spawn sub-actions like create_plan, investigate, and synthesise_findings using make_action_in_same_session
stream_report_results: stream synthesized report parts from the synthesise_findings action to the output report stream
